blocks.translation:
• This product is for ages 15 and up. Do not give it to children under the recommended age.
• Be careful of accidental swallowing of batteries (sold separately) or the battery cover.
• Do not use the product near the ear. Misuse may damage hearing.
• This product contains electronic components. If you use a pacemaker, keep this product away from your body.
• Do not stare at flashing LED lights. They may cause nausea or other ill effects.
• Take care that fingers, hair, or clothing do not get caught in rotating parts.
• Incorrect battery use can cause heating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following precautions.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert batteries with the correct +/− (polarity).
• After playing, always turn the switch off and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed can cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If battery fluid gets into the eyes, immediately rinse thoroughly with plenty of water and consult a physician. If fluid contacts skin or clothing, wash with water.
• When disposing of batteries, follow your local government's waste disposal instructions.

• This product contains delicate electronic parts. Do not drop it, get it wet, dirty it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in very high or very low temperatures.
